name: No-Clashing Teaching Dimension of the No-Clashing/Antichain Separation Class
proof: The samples $\varnothing,(x_2,1),(x_1,1),\{(x_1,1),(x_2,1)\},(x_0,1),\{(x_0,1),(x_2,1)\}$, assigned in the class-definition order, form a no-clashing teacher map of width two. Exhaustive enumeration rules out width one, so $\mathrm{NCTD}=2$; see $\texttt{sync/verify\_noclashing\_antichain\_gap.py}$.
references: Direct calculation from the class definition.
